claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the threshold feature for `frai eval`. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Implementation Summary

### Core Changes (frai-core)

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`** – Enhanced `generateReport` function:
- Accepts optional `thresholds` parameter (object like `{ exact_match: 0.9 }`)
- Evaluates each threshold against metric scores
- Returns `passed` flag (true if all pass) and `thresholds` array
- Each threshold entry contains `{ metric, min, score, passed }`
- Metrics with null scores automatically fail their threshold

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`** – Updated markdown formatter:
- Adds "Thresholds" section when thresholds are present
- Shows PASS/FAIL status for each threshold
- Displays min value, actual score, and pass/fail status

### CLI Changes (frai-cli)

**`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`** – Added threshold support:
- New `--threshold <metric=number>` option (repeatable)
- `parseThresholds()` function validates format and values
- Checks for unknown metrics and malformed thresholds
- Exit codes: 0 (all pass), 1 (any fail), 2 (usage error)
- Produces helpful error messages listing valid metric IDs
- Report written regardless of pass/fail

### Tests
Added 5 new test cases in `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`:
- Thresholds passing when scores meet minimums
- Thresholds failing when scores are below minimums
- Null scores failing thresholds
- Thresholds appearing correctly in markdown reports

### Documentation
Updated README files for both packages with:
- CLI option description and examples
- SDK usage examples with thresholds
- Exit code behavior documentation

### Validation
- TypeScript type checking passes
- Manual test confirmed threshold logic works correctly
- Backward compatible: without `--threshold`, behavior unchanged
- Supports custom metrics via `runEvaluations`

The implementation is ready for CI/CD integration where pipelines can now gate on evaluation metrics.
